title: Ring Buffer<T, N>
hints: The `%` is what makes it a ring: index `N` wraps back to 0. Draw the array on paper, push 7 values into a 5-slot buffer, and follow `m_head` and `m_count`.
requirements: `template <typename T, std::size_t N> class RingBuffer` over a `std::array<T, N>`, with a head index and a count
`push` adds at the newest end and overwrites the oldest when full
Use it for a "last 5 commands" history and a moving average of the last 10 numbers
stretch: An iterator from oldest to newest, so `for (const auto& x : buffer)` works.
